title: Quarantined Arrival
description: Peppermint arrives in a latch-top Mason jar with a note that says “Hi I’m Peppermint #quarantined,” plus a handwritten welcome letter to Nivaan — a very 2020 first appearance.

title: Elf Surveillance
description: The house is officially under “Elf Surveillance.” Peppermint sits by a toy station-wagon and a handwritten Elf Rules letter (don’t touch, talk to me, write Santa letters, be kind), with “Santa’s watching!” signs on the wall.
supplies: Printable or handmade Elf Surveillance and Santa’s watching signs

title: Minion Bananas
description: Peppermint grabbed a Sharpie and drew Minion faces on a bunch of bananas, then posed with a little yellow Minion toy as if they were in on it together.

title: Polaroid Paparazzi
description: The elf sits with a white Instax Mini camera, proudly holding an instant print, with a few more snapshots fanned out beside him.

title: Catboy Ate the Nutella
description: An open Nutella jar, a chocolate-smeared elf, and a PJ Masks Catboy figure holding a spread knife — someone’s been in the chocolate, and Catboy is getting the blame.
supplies: A dab of chocolate for faces

title: Breakfast in the Mixer
description: Peppermint climbs into the KitchenAid bowl wearing an egg as a chef’s hat, with a sign that says “I MADE YOU BREAKFAST. EAT UP!” A pan of scrambled eggs, a hash brown, and sausage waits on the stove.

title: Santa’s Cookie Is Missing
description: The elf peeks through the die-cut hole of a “Santa’s Cookie is Missing!” board book, as if he’s the one who nabbed the cookie.
supplies: Santa’s Cookie is Missing board book (or any book with a window or hole)

title: Toilet Paper Tumble
description: A classic: a trail of toilet paper unrolls all the way down the stairs, with Peppermint wrapped in the last square at the bottom.

title: Magic Elf Seeds
description: Night one: a chalkboard reads “Magic Elf seeds! Plant them all in a row, wait for the magic and see what will grow,” with the elf in a mug. Night two: “Ta-da!” — pretzel rods have sprouted in the mug.
supplies: Small seeds or beads for day one
Pretzel rods or breadsticks for the reveal

title: Living Room Race Track
description: Painter’s-tape lanes and a STOP line turn the carpet under the tree into a racetrack, packed with tiny cars and the elf sitting on the back stretch.

title: Hanging Around the Tree
description: Peppermint dangles upside-down from the Christmas tree like he’s just another ornament, arms wide among the bulbs and stockings.
supplies: Christmas tree (a branch or ornament hook to hang from)

title: Candy Cane Swing
description: The elf swings from a candy cane clipped to a paper snowflake-and-circle garland hanging on the wall.

title: Toilet-Paper Snowman
description: Three stacked toilet-paper rolls become a snowman with twig arms and a drawn face, plus a little card inviting the kids to give him a scarf. Mini trees and paper houses sit beside him on the windowsill.
supplies: Twigs or pipe cleaners for arms

title: The Snowman Melted
description: Peppermint holds a sad little note — “I BROUGHT YOU A SNOWMAN, BUT IT MELTED :(” — next to a plate of raisins (or chocolate chips) and a carrot stick, all that’s left of the snowman.

title: Flour Snow Angel
description: Peppermint lies in a flour snow angel on the counter, holding a sign: “TODAY, LET’S BAKE COOKIES FOR SANTA TOGETHER.” Eggs, brown sugar, chocolate chips, and ornaments are scattered around the mess.

title: Cookie-Tin Climber
description: The elf stacks cans and jars into a tower so he can climb the kitchen cabinets and raid a tin of cookies left on the counter.
supplies: Cookie tin or bowl of cookies

title: Clown Noses on the Photos
description: Peppermint poses in a picture frame after sticking red clown noses on the family photos — including a framed portrait of mom and dad.
supplies: An extra frame for the elf (optional)

title: Skittles Rainbow Experiment
description: A card says “Let’s do a fun experiment! Pour warm water on to the plate and watch what happens.” Rainbow candies are arranged in rings; the next photo shows the colors bleeding into a pinwheel.

title: The Hungry Caterpillar
description: Green apples lined up behind a smiling red-apple head (with pipe-cleaner antennae) make a Very Hungry Caterpillar, and Peppermint is riding it.
supplies: Pipe cleaners or toothpicks for antennae
Marker or candy for a face

title: Climbing the City
description: A handmade cardboard skyscraper with glowing yellow windows becomes a nighttime city, and the elf scales the side like a superhero while tiny figures and a car wait on the street below.
supplies: Yellow tissue or lights behind cut-out windows
Small toy figures and a toy car
A light source behind the building

title: Christmas Lights Mission
description: Peppermint sits on a toy car in front of a glowing white house, with a note: go drive around, look at Christmas lights with the family, and play Christmas music. Photographed at night and again the next morning.
supplies: Printed note about looking at Christmas lights

title: Tic-Tac-Toe with Santa
description: A Santa figurine climbs a red toy ladder by the window while Peppermint sits on the sill mid-game at a snowman-shaped tic-tac-toe board.

title: Toy Tower Good Deed
description: Peppermint stands on a stack of toy vehicles with a note asking Nivaan to pick out three toys he no longer needs and leave them under the tree so Santa can take them to other kids.
supplies: Toy cars, trucks, and figures to stack

title: Spa Day
description: A SPA DAY sign, flameless candles, and fairy lights set the mood while Peppermint soaks in a bowl of cotton-ball bubbles, surrounded by tiny bottles, plants, and shells.

title: The Night Before Christmas
description: On Christmas Eve, Peppermint sits down with a cup of cocoa to read The Night Before Christmas, with a ’Twas the Night Before Christmas booklet and a little gingerbread house nearby — last night of 2020.

title: Donut Worry, I’m Back!
description: Peppermint’s 2021 return: a framed “DONUT WORRY I’M BACK!!!” sign, a stand of donuts, and a table full of cozy extras — stuffed toys, a Jingle Crew shirt, and more donut-themed treats.
supplies: Printed Donut Worry I’m Back sign and frame

title: Oreo Midnight Snack
description: The elf lounges with an open pack of Oreos and a plate of cookies, mid-snack in the glow of the Christmas lights.

title: Help, I’m Stuck in the TV
description: The living-room TV shows the elf’s face and a plea: “HELP… I HIT THE WRONG BUTTON ON THE REMOTE… HOW DO I GET OUT OF HERE?”
supplies: TV or computer that can display the photo
On-screen text (slides, caption, or a simple graphic)

title: Time-Out
description: Peppermint stands in the corner with a stern note: “Shouting & Crying makes me sad…. I will not work when your behavior is BAD!!!”

title: Your Dad Farted
description: The elf hides in a glass jar with a note: “Your Dad FARTED! Don’t worry, I can’t smell anything in here!! — Peppermint.”

title: Warm & Toasty
description: Peppermint is tucked under a slice of toast on a plate, with a note: “I was cold! It’s warm & Toasty :)” The toaster sits ready in the background.

title: Foil-Wrapped Elf
description: Four foil-wrapped bundles (they look like baked potatoes) sit in a row on the floor, and Peppermint is wrapped in foil too, as if he got baked along with them.
supplies: Potatoes or other items to wrap (or just foil bundles)

title: Banister Sled Ride
description: A long board is laid on the staircase banister as a ramp, and Peppermint rides a little black sled straight down the stairs.
supplies: Long board or piece of cardboard
Small sled, tray, or shoe as a vehicle

title: Ouch, I Fell
description: Peppermint’s arm is in a sling, a skateboard is snapped, a toy car is tipped over, and a note says “ouch!! I fell over last night. Please clean up… — Peppermint.”
supplies: Cloth or tape for a sling

title: Family-Size Elf Cereal
description: A custom Elf on the Shelf family-size cereal box is set out with a bottle of milk, a bowl of cereal, a spoon, and a ring of fairy lights — breakfast, courtesy of Peppermint.
supplies: Cereal box (printable Elf on the Shelf cover or a store box)
Milk in a small bottle or glass

title: Toy Car Spiral
description: Dozens of toy cars are arranged in a spiral on the carpet, leading inward to Peppermint and a little bag in the middle of the room.

title: Let’s Go Fishin’
description: Peppermint sits on top of a spinning Let’s Go Fishin’ game, holding a tiny rod over the plastic fish.
supplies: Let’s Go Fishin’ or similar fishing game

title: Take Me for Show & Tell
description: A note says “Today you can take me to school for Show & Tell,” and a lighted travel jar holds a picture of Peppermint labeled “I’m Peppermint — Do not touch me,” so the real elf can stay home.
supplies: Clear jar or container with a lid

title: Treat Yo Elf
description: A green TREAT YO ELF sweatshirt hangs on the tree from a Hershey’s bar, with Peppermint perched above it like he brought a present.
supplies: Treat Yo Elf (or similar) sweatshirt or shirt
Hershey’s bar or ornament to hang it from

title: Stuck in the Blinds
description: Peppermint is wedged in the window blinds, peeking out between the slats.

title: Sleeping Mustache
description: While Nivaan was asleep, the elf left him with a drawn-on mustache and a little goatee — a cheeky overnight prank. The photo includes the sleeping child.
supplies: Washable face paint or a washable marker

title: Magic Dust Cupcake
description: Peppermint leaves a tiny bottle of “magic dust” and a note: “Sprinkle some magic dust… And wait for a magic to happen.” Nearby, a cupcake has turned into a giant gold-foil treat with a bow.
supplies: Mini glass bottle with white powder (sugar or flour)

title: Math Balloons
description: White balloons hang from the tree with addition problems written on them (7+5, 7+7, 2+3+4…), and Peppermint dangles in the middle like he’s teaching class.
supplies: Christmas tree or a place to hang them

title: Santa’s Zip Line
description: Peppermint and a Santa figurine ride a zip line (a red line or rod) down from the tree toward the window.
supplies: String, fishing line, or a long toy track
Tape or hooks to anchor the line

title: Elf’s Car Dealership
description: A whole dealership lot: toy cars parked in rows, a photo of a real car lot, a waving inflatable tube-man, and Peppermint standing in a felt-ball light frame as the salesman.

title: Brown-E’s
description: Peppermint (plus a tiny helper) wears a whisk and spatula on the stove. A baking sheet of letter E’s is labeled “Brown-E’s,” and the follow-up shot is a foil pan with a note: “I made you some brownies. Enjoy!!”

title: Toys for Other Kids
description: A card asks for a good deed: pick out three toys you no longer need, leave them under the tree tonight, and Santa will take them to other girls and boys. Peppermint sits on the tree skirt with a tiny elf friend.

title: Paint-a-Snowflake Kit
description: The night before Christmas Eve, the elves leave a Paint-a-Snowflake ornament kit and a gingerbread-themed gift bag — a craft to do together.

title: I’m Back (and I Missed You)
description: Peppermint’s 2022 arrival: he pops out of a decorative box of gingerbread-house paper, candy canes, and fairy lights, with a red tag that says “I’M BACK and I missed you.”

title: Taped to the Wall
description: Peppermint is stuck to the wall in a spread-eagle pose with strips of packing tape, the tape roll still hanging off one arm. A tiny elf in a pot watches from a hook above.
supplies: Packing or painter’s tape (painter’s is safer for paint)
Optional tiny elf and a small pot

title: Pancakes, Anyone?
description: The elves sit down to a plate of pancakes with Hershey’s syrup and whipped cream, and a note that simply asks, “Pancakes Anyone.”

title: Add With Me
description: The big elf and a tiny elf set out addition flash cards (3+2, 1+4) and a napkin that says “ADD with ME.”
supplies: Paper or napkin and a marker

title: Taco Tuesday
description: Two elves are wrapped in tortillas and laid on a plate like tacos, with a napkin that shouts “It’s Taco-Tuesday!!”
supplies: Marker and a napkin or note

title: Jenga Night
description: Peppermint and a tiny elf play a mini game of Jenga on the counter, with a Minion sitting in as the audience.
supplies: Optional Minion or other toy spectator

title: Unicorn Ride
description: Peppermint is in the saddle of a toy ride-on unicorn parked on the tree skirt, ready for a morning spin.

title: Flu Season
description: Both elves are laid out “sick” on the tree skirt, surrounded by crumpled tissues and a little cup, as if Peppermint caught the flu too.

title: Ginger Bread House
description: A note asks, “How do you like my ginger bread house??” — but the house is an A-frame tent made of regular sandwich bread, with a tiny elf looking on.

title: Burrito Elves
description: Both elves are rolled up in tortillas and hung on the tree with a note: “It’s so cold I had to wrap up tight …… brrrr!!”

title: Elf Cereal, Round Two
description: A second-year Elf on the Shelf family-size cereal box (chocolate flavor this time) sits on the table with both elves, a little breakfast tradition coming back.
supplies: Cereal box (printable Elf on the Shelf cover or a store box)

title: Elf on Strike
description: No elf in sight — just a lined note hanging on the tree: “ELF ON STRIKE. Too much naughty behavior. I’m staying at the North Pole until the good listening returns.”
supplies: Christmas tree (or a place to hang the note)

title: A Mug for Nivaan
description: A letter to Nivaan (“I missed you so much! Thanks for listening and being good. Enjoy your treat!!”) sits with a gift mug and an Incredible Elf mug-set box.

title: I Borrowed the Butt Brush
description: A bathroom-mirror note says “I borrowed the Butt Brush. Hope you don’t mind. Have a nice day!!” Peppermint is stuffed in the toothbrush cup next to the toothpaste, with a tiny elf on lookout.
supplies: Toilet paper or a sticky note

title: Have an Eggcellent Day
description: Faces are drawn on a carton of eggs, the elves sit with them on the counter, and a note reads “Have an Eggcellent day!! — P.”

title: Magic Broccoli (Gotcha!)
description: A letter claims the broccoli is sprinkled with MAGIC that makes you invisible once you eat it, and to open the envelope afterward. The envelope’s reveal: “HA HA!! MADE YOU EAT BROCCOLI… GOTCHA!! — Peppermint & Honey.”
supplies: Sealed envelope with the GOTCHA letter

title: Don’t Swallow the Bubble Gum
description: A big blue balloon stands in as a giant bubble, a pack of bubble gum sits nearby, and a sign warns: “DON’T SWALLOW BUBBLE GUM!!”

title: Cookie Stack
description: The elves sit beside a tall stack of cookies with marshmallows and a lit tea light — a tiny cookie campfire on the counter.

title: Goodbye, Friends!
description: Christmas Eve 2022: a printed “GOODBYE Friends!” letter from the elf is held up in front of the tree, with a little elf ornament hanging among the lights.

title: Surprise! We’re Back
description: Both elves pop out of a big wrapped gift box with a sign that says “Surprise!! We’re BACK,” and chocolates and candy are scattered around the box.
supplies: Printed or handwritten We’re BACK sign

title: UNO Night
description: The two elves sit at the kitchen counter with a spread of UNO cards and the box, mid-game.

title: Top of the Cabinet
description: The elves have climbed all the way up onto a tall cabinet and are sitting with a row of tiny white houses and a bottle-brush tree.
supplies: Optional mini houses or a mini tree

title: Sponge Cake
description: A sign says “We made a Sponge Cake for you!” — and the “cake” on the stand is stacked kitchen sponges with a cherry-like top.

title: We Shrunk Your Rubik’s Cube
description: The elves present a tiny Rubik’s cube on a plate with a straight-faced sign: “We shrunk your Rubik’s cube.”
supplies: Mini Rubik’s cube (or a regular one presented as shrunken)

title: Cut Here, Save Me
description: One elf hangs upside-down from the tree topper and the other dangles on a line below, with a paper tag that reads “CUT HERE SAVE ME” — an invitation to rescue them.
supplies: A hook or ornament cap at the top

title: Nerf War
description: The elves have staged a living-room blaster fight: a big X-Shot / Nerf-style gun, a second blaster, and foam darts all over the carpet.

title: Feeding the Dolphins
description: Bananas float in a bowl of blue water on the windowsill, and the elves hold them as if they’re feeding dolphins.
supplies: Water with blue food coloring (or blue gelatin)

title: Bake Some Cookies
description: Under the family photos, the elves leave an Elf on the Shelf Holiday Sugar Cookie Kit and a note that says “Bake Some Cookies!”

title: Banana Bread
description: A sign announces “WE MADE YOU BANANA BREAD!” The “bread” is just a banana sandwiched between two slices of bread.

title: Rock, Paper, Scissors
description: The elves sit in the window with a sign — “Let’s Play Rock Paper Scissors” — plus a blank sheet of paper and a pair of scissors, ready for a match.

title: I Did Not Do It
description: One elf holds a yellow sign that says “I did not do it,” while the other is stuffed upside-down in a water bottle labeled HELP, trapped under a full Purified Water bottle.
supplies: Empty plastic bottle (wide enough, or a cut bottle)
A full water bottle to stack on top

title: Help Us Build the Fort
description: Blue building bricks are scattered across the table around a half-built fort, with a sign: “HELP US BUILD THE FORT.”

title: Upside-Down Ceiling Elves
description: Both elves hang from the ceiling like bats, hats pointing at the floor — a simple, striking pose if you have removable hooks or putty.
supplies: Removable hooks, poster putty, or tape that won’t damage the ceiling

title: Favorite Place Is With You
description: The elves sit with a small globe and a note: “I have Travelled all around the world, but my favorite place is with you!”

title: Color Our Pictures
description: Printouts of the elves and a handful of markers come with a request: “Can you make our pictures colorful?”

title: Living-Room Zip Line
description: One elf is perched on the chandelier and the other is mid-ride on a string zip line stretched across the living room.
supplies: A light fixture or hook on one end and a far anchor on the other
Tape or a clip to hang the riding elf

title: Marshmallow House
description: The elves have built a little geometric house out of marshmallows and toothpicks (or pretzel sticks) and left a plate of extras with a note: “We Built a Marshmallow House for you… Do you want to build one?”

title: We Went Fishing
description: A note on the windowsill says “Went fishing and got some fish for you!” The elves hold makeshift rods next to a couple of gummy fish.
supplies: Swedish Fish or other gummy fish

title: Watching You All Night
description: Christmas Eve morning: popcorn, a toilet-paper-roll telescope labeled YOU, and a note — “You asked us to watch YouTube yesterday, so we did. We have been watching it all night but it’s boring.” Last night of 2023.

title: Mantel Duty
description: The two elves perch on the mantel with a small doll, right next to a home security camera — as if they’re on watch too.

title: Giraffe Riders
description: The elves climb onto a pair of decorative wooden giraffes, and one giraffe even gets its own Santa hat.
supplies: Decorative giraffes (or any tall animal figures)

title: Mirror Tic-Tac-Toe
description: A tic-tac-toe game is drawn on the bathroom mirror, already in progress, with one elf drawing and the other watching from the frame. Photographed late on December 23.
supplies: Dry-erase marker or something that wipes off easily
